name: sonzai-claude-skill
description: Two plugins for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) building on the Sonzai SDK. PUBLIC plugin ships three skills: (1) sonzai-sdk — wizard for human-in-the-loop spec+plan; (2) full-auto — autonomous closed-loop: transcript → tech-stack derivation OR brownfield audit → masterplan → builder subagent (always-search-current-state) → docker-compose deploy → functional QA → auto-fixer; (3) cto-loop — semi-autonomous: same pipeline + two operator gates (masterplan approval + live-app review) + interactive 7-question tech-stack intake + operator-feedback-driven fixer loop. INTERNAL plugin ships sonzai-internal-staff (install-time gated). All three public skills share core infrastructure: version-checker subagent (no version hallucination), builder/fixer/auditor subagents, docker-compose templates for postgres/postgres+redis/stateless deploys. v1.6.0 added cto-loop and moved shared core to full-auto/.
